errors.busy: omp has a menu open. Close it in the terminal sheet, then try again.

permission.title: Permission level
permission.tooltip: How much omp may do before it asks you.
permission.scopeNote: Saved for this project, so every open chat in it follows the change.

always-ask.label: Ask me first
always-ask.description: omp asks before it edits files or runs commands.

write.label: Edits OK
write.description: omp edits project files on its own and asks before it runs commands.

yolo.label: Auto
yolo.description: omp edits files and runs commands without asking.

autoConfirm.title: Turn on Auto?
autoConfirm.description: Auto lets omp edit files and run commands without asking. Use it only in projects you trust.

model.title: Choose a model
model.tooltip: Choose the model that answers in this chat.
model.empty: No models match. Try a shorter search.
model.noModels: omp has no models yet. Connect a provider to add some.
model.scopeNote: Applies to this chat only. New chats use your default model.

thinking.title: Thinking
thinking.unsupported: This model has no thinking levels.
thinking.failed: omp could not switch to that thinking level.

auto.label: Auto
auto.description: omp sets the effort for each request.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.description: Short answers with a little reasoning.

chip.tooltip: Change the permission level or turn on a work mode.

restart.title: Restart omp
restart.hint: Restart the omp process for this chat. The chat history is kept.

compact.title: Compact this chat
compact.hint: Summarize the chat so far to free context space.

plan.title: Plan mode
plan.hint: omp drafts a plan for your approval before it changes anything.

goal.title: Set a goal
goal.hint: Describe the outcome you want. omp plans the steps and works toward it.

guided.title: Guided goal
guided.hint: omp asks a few questions, then sets up a goal.

vibe.title: Vibe mode
vibe.hint: omp directs background helpers that do the editing and running, then checks their work.

loop.title: Repeat a task
loop.hint: Repeat a request a set number of times, for a set time, or until a check passes.

advisor.title: Toggle advisor
advisor.hint: Turn the advisor on or off. It is a second model that reviews each turn and adds notes.

handoff.title: Write a handoff
handoff.hint: Summarize this chat into a handoff document and continue from it with less context.

security.title: Run security scan
security.hint: Start omp's security scan for this project.

cleanse.title: Cleanse project
cleanse.hint: Find and fix errors and warnings across the project with parallel helpers.

export.title: Export chat
export.hint: Save this chat as an HTML file.

rename.title: Rename chat
rename.hint: Give this chat a name you can find later.

model.title: Choose model
model.hint: Choose the model that answers in this chat.

tree.title: Open session tree
tree.hint: Show every branch of this chat as a map.

fork.title: Fork chat
fork.hint: Copy this chat into a new one to try another direction.

rewind.title: Rewind to here
rewind.hint: Go back to this point. The original path stays in the tree as a branch.

forkFrom.title: Fork from here
forkFrom.hint: Start a new chat from this message and leave this one unchanged.

compact.title: Compact this chat
compact.description: omp summarizes the conversation so far to free context space.
compact.label: What should the summary keep? (optional)

handoff.title: Write a handoff
handoff.description: omp summarizes this chat into a handoff document and compacts the context around it, so work continues here with less context.
handoff.label: What should the handoff focus on? (optional)

rename.title: Rename this chat
rename.description: Choose a short name you can find later.
rename.label: Chat name

guided.title: Set up a guided goal
guided.description: Describe a rough objective. omp asks a few questions, then sets up the goal.
guided.label: What do you want to accomplish? (optional)

goal.title: Work toward a goal
goal.description: Describe the outcome you want. omp plans the steps and works toward it.
goal.budgetHint: A positive number. Leave it blank for no limit.
goal.activeBody: This chat has an active goal. You can pause it or drop it.
goal.pausedBody: This chat has a paused goal. Resume it to continue, or drop it.

loop.title: Repeat a task
loop.description: omp repeats your next request until the limit or check is reached. Press Esc to pause the loop.
loop.promptHint: Leave it blank to repeat the next request you send.

security.disabled: Security scanning is turned off in omp settings.

plan.waiting: omp is waiting for your approval before it starts.
plan.missing: The plan file is not available yet.
plan.exitDescription: This leaves plan mode without approving the current plan.

done.execute: Plan approved. omp is starting the work.
done.compact: Plan approved. omp is compacting the chat first.
done.keep: Plan approved with the full chat context.
done.refine: Write your comment in the composer, then send it.
done.save: Plan saved. omp has stopped this chat.

tree.title: Session tree
tree.description: Every branch of this chat, from the first message to the current point.
tree.emptyHint: Send a message to start the tree.
tree.selectHint: Select a message to preview it.
tree.noBranches: No branches yet. Fork or rewind to try another approach.
tree.noText: This entry has no message text.

navigate.noFile: This chat has no saved session file yet.
navigate.busy: Wait for the current response to finish, then move to another point.
navigate.missing: That message is no longer in this chat.
navigate.unsupported: That entry cannot be opened from the session tree.
navigate.notFound: omp could not find that message in its tree. The original chat is unchanged.
navigate.unconfirmed: omp did not confirm the move. The original chat is unchanged.
navigate.forkTimeout: omp did not finish switching sessions in time.
